title: 宝塚記念の後に・強えからこそ渇くのよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One and Tamamo Cross both lose. Tamamo Cross, frustrated by this loss, swears she'll never let victory slip away again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is moved by her rival's unflagging thirst for victory, and she vows to be the one to win the Takarazuka Kinen the following year.
